name: Leonidas Code
releaseDefinition: One Leonidas app for beginner and aspiring vibe coders: harness, personalized AIOS, dictation and clipboard as one supported workflow on Windows, with remote web access (Mac follows launch, per Jake 2026-10-13). V1.0 is the explicit public launch and needs Jake's approval after the five-user and 20-user gates pass.

milestones.title: Feasibility check
milestones.goal: A clean Windows PC runs the current harness end to end, every target provider sign-in is tried, and every launch cost and provider term is listed.
